brief:
Residents of Manara district in Gaza staged a demonstration to warn of tents sinking in the area, the Ma'an news agency reported. The protest highlighted deteriorating conditions in the neighborhood as displacement camps face ongoing challenges from environmental and structural issues.

Details of the specific causes behind the sinking tents and the scale of the problem were not immediately clear from initial reports of the gathering.
title: Gaza residents protest sinking tents in Manara district
